He carried it upstairs and searched the old logbooks. On that date, a storm had swallowed a fishing boat beyond the reef. Then he lit the lamp, watched its beam cross the dark water, and hoped someone out there could see it.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有醒透。路灯把空荡的街道照成淡黄色，便利店的玻璃门偶尔响一声。清洁车缓缓驶过，留下湿润的路面。早点铺里，师傅揉着面团，蒸笼冒出第一缕白气。远处的高楼只有几扇窗亮着，像有人替夜守着最后一班岗。天边渐渐发白，送报人骑车穿过路口，鸟鸣从树梢落下来。城市深吸一口气，准备迎接新的一天。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by asking a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then another, until you find a toy.\n- The smallest box is where you stop; then you finish each bigger box on your way back."}
